basic_info.description: Discover the rarity of Townhome 2A, an expansive, nearly 1,100 square foot residence offering a versatile dual-level layout with two entrances, a private street-level entry & second-floor access to the amenity wing. This thoughtfully designed home features 1BD/1.5BA, a dedicated office, and deeded parking.  The main level offers a spacious living/dining area with flexible layouts, a gourmet kitchen with an eat-in bar, two closets and Miele washer and dryer. Upstairs, the owner's suite impresses with soaring 10.5 foot ceilings and a flexible layout that comfortably accommodates both sleeping and sitting areas. There is a spacious bathroom, and expansive walk-in closet. The dramatic corner windows flood the room with natural light. A custom Murphy bed with storage completes this room and adds further versatility. Adjacent to the suite is a home office, an additional large closet, and a second entrance for seamless access to amenities, and common areas. Townhome 2A is a rare blend of privacy, volume, and flexibility, making it one of The Infinity's most coveted floor plans. The Infinity's resort-style amenities include a 24-hour doorman, club room with a full catering kitchen, courtyard, 5,000 sq. ft. fitness center, 75-ft lap pool, sauna, theater room, business center & more.
